prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ZuluNiner aviation blog cover, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: restrained editorial illustration about a light airplane's maneuvering speed and loading.
Scene/backdrop: a light single-engine piston airplane in a gentle bank over open countryside, with a few broad, subtle curved airflow bands behind it. The airplane dominates the composition and has a clearly coherent wing, tail and propeller arrangement.
Style/medium: sophisticated flat graphic illustration with crisp aircraft silhouette, lightly textured surfaces, muted blue, warm ivory and sage, matching an understated aviation magazine.
Composition/framing: aircraft centered with ample margin around both wingtips and tail, three-quarter view, shallow bank only; calm air rather than a dramatic storm. No people.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no charts or labels, no registration marks, no logos, no watermark. No damage or exaggerated wing bending. This is a fictional aircraft editorial illustration, not a photograph of a listed aircraft.
